comment: Katelyn is an amazing professor!! I want to major in International Studies because of her class. I really feel like I learned a lot! Reading is a lot, but if you take notes in class, you should be alright. Make sure you read the news, because she does give quizzes on that!

She was a new teacher and it was obvious. She did not put up with any bs from anyone and was not a pushover, but gave A's where most other teachers might gives Bs. Reading is advised, but is never too much. Can be a blow off class Is needed. Highly recommend it.

Katelyn is a very approachable professor.  She doesn't really believe in finals so our final grade in the class was a policy paper that we wrote in stages. She gives very clear feedback on assignments, placing handwritten notes in the margins and attaching typewritten notes on the back.

Katelyn is a very kind woman. She will help you if need it, so office hours are a must. Downside was that the class seemed to have little direction. Didn't like the readings too much. But she's new, so you have to cut her some slack. Other than that, Katelyn is a very approachable professor. You can be sure she will try her best to help you succeed

Don't do it. A LOT of readings and she really does expect you to read it all. Total of 5 essays where you have to talk about 2 of the readings. For the majority of the class, you won't even understand what we're talking about and you won't learn anything honestly. She's a new teacher but wouldn't listen to any of our feedbacks on her teaching lol
